name: Broom of Flying

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

powers.name: Ride
powers.text: Sit astride it: a Fly Speed of 50 ft (30 ft if you carry more than 200 lb).

summary: Ride it through the air: a Fly Speed of 50 ft; it can also fly alone to a place you name.
text: Until you straddle it and say its command word, this is just an ordinary wooden broom. Once activated, it floats under you and carries you through the air; its Fly Speed is 50 feet. It bears up to 400 pounds, though any load over 200 pounds slows it to a Fly Speed of 30 feet. Landing ends the hover. You can also dispatch the broom on its own: say the command word and name a place you know within 1 mile, and it flies there. A second command word calls it back, as long as it hasn't strayed beyond 1 mile from you.
